description: Get the optimal provider recommendation for a model based on cost, latency, reliability, or balanced optimization. Shows savings vs your current cost.

blocked_providers.description: Provider IDs to exclude from recommendations

current_cost_per_million.description: What you currently pay per million tokens (avg of input+output), for savings estimate

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum acceptable P95 latency in ms (default: 5000)

model.description: Model name or partial match to filter offerings (e.g. "llama-70b", "gpt-4o")
